desc: Given an array temperatures of daily temperatures, return an array answer where answer[i] is the number of days you must wait after day i to get a warmer temperature. If there is no future warmer day, answer[i] is 0.
hints: For each day, scanning forward is O(n²) in the worst case.
Days still waiting for a warmer day form a pile; the newest waiting day is on top.
Keep a stack of indices with decreasing temperatures. A warmer day resolves everything colder on top of the stack.
editorial: Maintain a stack of indices whose temperatures are in decreasing order (they are still waiting). For the current day i, while the top of the stack has a lower temperature, pop it as j and set answer[j] = i - j. Then push i.
This is the classic monotonic stack: every index is pushed and popped at most once.
